title: Shattered Foundation | ECHO//100 Episode 79
description:
Kavi confronts his hollow progenitor as reality fractures into a mosaic of conflicting timelines. Episode 79 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an original work of fiction created with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: Glass walls splinter, revealing a thousand versions of Kavi bleeding into the sterile room.
scenes.caption: Glass walls fracturing
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of Kavi in his red hoodie standing in a glass room, walls cracking with holographic visions of his life, cinematic lighting.

scenes.text: The Original Kavi lunges, movements jagged, desperate to preserve the doorway’s dark, hollow heart.
scenes.caption: Original Kavi attacks
scenes.image_prompt: An older, hollow-eyed version of Kavi lunging forward, red hoodie tattered, inside a fractured glass bedroom.

scenes.text: Mira projects raw historical data, attempting to overload the door’s unstable, flickering power core.
scenes.caption: Mira projecting data
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal coat holding a glowing blue holographic interface, Byte floating beside her with an orange antenna glowing.

scenes.text: The archive pulses against his chest, yet the Original Kavi ignores the digital cold.
scenes.caption: Archive pulses red
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi holding a glowing data-shard, the Original Kavi shrugging off the energy, dark purple glitch effects swirling around him.

scenes.text: His eyes soften as Kavi broadcasts a cherished memory of a distant, fading sunset.
scenes.caption: Shared warm memory
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's glasses reflecting a warm orange sunset memory, Original Kavi looking confused and vulnerable.

scenes.text: Kavi ceases fighting, choosing instead to offer the kindness the Original never knew.
scenes.caption: Choosing empathy
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi lowering his guard, reaching out his hand to the Original Kavi, soft golden light emanating between them.

scenes.text: As data flows, the hollow shell dissolves into Kavi, rewriting the foundation of reality.
scenes.caption: Merging timelines
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi and the Original Kavi beginning to overlap, their bodies turning into glowing particles of red and white light.

scenes.text: No longer two, a single, balanced boy stands amidst the silent, shattered glass.
scenes.caption: Final merge complete
scenes.image_prompt: A single Kavi standing in the center of the room, looking at his hands, the glass walls now perfectly still.
